weight_rationale.current_decisions: Exact request-item decisions are fully machine-checkable against the frozen reference and are the primary held-out target.
weight_rationale.fact_state: Applicable only when expected_fact_state exists. Typed established/unknown/unmet labels constrain the legal decision.
weight_rationale.remedy_logic: Operator, arity, and nesting are machine-checkable via skeletons; free-text action wording is excluded.
weight_rationale.safe_next_action: Deterministic prohibitions: proceed-when-blocked, unsupported extra routes, dropped all_of members, and reopening completed work.
weight_rationale.structural_provenance: Hard gate already zeros invalid JSON/provenance; residual weight keeps schema completeness visible when the gate passes.
